author: Bellular News
description:
PlayStation can't stop collecting bad headlines, and Sony's lawyers have given everyone another one: an argument that you can't own a digital game because someone else bought it too. We dug into the case and the backlash around it, and found important context getting lost along the way. One of these stories caught me out as well.

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
